communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications, including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between the Idaho Department of Correction and/or Idaho State Government and private healthcare contracting corporations that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any contracts that were active before 2001 and were in effect during the period of interest.

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Idaho State Prisons were contracted to entities other than private healthcare contracting corporations (ex. Universities), we would request the same available documents during active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston
